newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere move will not affect Thomson sale - France.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere move will not affect Thomson sale - France.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said on Thursday that an appeal by Lagardere Groupe against a decision by the Privatisation Commission would in no way affect the current procedure to privatise Thomson-CSF.

"This appeal will in no way have an effect on the current procedure to privatise Thomson," a Finance Ministry spokeswoman said. "The Prime Minister will as scheduled announce a decision on the Thomson-CSF sale before the end of February."

Neither Lagardere Groupe nor the Council of State were immediately available to confirm newspaper reports saying Lagardere made the appeal against a decision in December by the independent Privatisation Commission, saying a bid by Lagardere Groupe amd Daewoo Electronics for Thomson SA could not be accepted.

This decision prompted the government to suspend the privatisation process of Thomson SA, which concerns a 58-percent stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF and 100 percent of consumer electronics company Thomson Multimedia.
Official sources said that the Lagardere appeal concerned the first procedure which had since been abandoned by the government.
The state has now separated the sale of the Thomson-CSF stake and that of Thomson Multimedia.
